subject: Fix build of select and evport ae backends: undeclared UNUSED() (#5299)
reason: The change is a build fix only: it swaps the undeclared UNUSED(state) macro for AE_NOTUSED(state) in the aeApiGetPollFd stubs of ae_select.c and ae_evport.c so those event-loop backends compile again. Both macros are identical no-op void casts, so compiled behaviour is unchanged; moreover the select and evport backends are not even built on the Linux hosts the fuzzer runs on (epoll is used), so no runtime path can reach the change. A build/compile fix with no behaviour change needs no scenario.
